glosses: To get back, to regain (a physical thing; in astronomy and navigation, sight of a thing or a signal).

examples.text: After days of inquiries, he finally recovered his lost wallet.

examples.text: They recovered three of the explorers very much alive, then another, wracked with severe hypothermia, who was taken to hospital.

glosses: To obtain a positive judgement; to win in a lawsuit.

examples.text: The plaintiff recovered in his suit, being awarded declaratory relief and a clearing of his name.

glosses: To gain as compensation or reparation, usually by formal legal process.

examples.text: The wine in my bottle will recover him.
